findings: `learner.overview.text` needs a clearer, plain-language explanation of the proposed borrowing: the container picture may have been reused to write “use” because the words were thought to sound alike. State that this is a proposed mechanism and that the container’s spoken name is unknown, so the sound match cannot be verified. The current wording says “sound similar” but does not make the borrowing mechanism clear to a first-time reader. Cite the existing supporting evidence IDs.
